batch.validate.summary: Validate an ordered CAD batch offline without contacting Fusion; reports the effective atomic mode.

inputs.timeBudgetMs: Positive integer scheduling budget; scoped default 180000 ms, legacy unbounded. No remote cancellation.
inputs.definitions: Named definition library; see definition expand.
inputs.operations: Ordered leaf, use, repeat or forEach steps.
inputs.parameters: Optional literal values substituted through sole-key {$param: name} objects.
inputs.reportPath: Local report directory; unused in validation.
inputs.atomic: Boolean, default true. Omitted or true selects atomic execution; only explicit false selects non-atomic. Invalid types (strings, numbers, arrays, objects) are rejected, never coerced.

limitations: Checks structure, catalog fields, IDs, references, cycles, and parameters only; no geometric or model-state validation.
Reports the effective atomic mode and atomic capability (addin only) without contacting a backend; atomic execution is supported only on the addin backend, and mcp is rejected at run time.

batch.preview.summary: Return the validated expanded batch without executing or writing reports; reports the effective atomic mode.

inputs.timeBudgetMs: Positive integer scheduling budget; scoped default 180000 ms, legacy unbounded. No remote cancellation.
inputs.definitions: Named definition library; see definition expand.
inputs.operations: Ordered leaf, use, repeat or forEach steps; references remain symbolic.
inputs.atomic: Boolean, default true. Omitted or true selects atomic execution; only explicit false selects non-atomic. Invalid types are rejected, never coerced.

limitations: No Fusion calls, no mutation, no filesystem writes, and no output-path or geometry verification.
Reports the effective atomic mode and atomic capability (addin only) without contacting a backend.

batch.run.summary: Execute an ordered batch atomically by default (one native command transaction), with an explicit atomic: false opt-out to the legacy per-step execution.

inputs.timeBudgetMs: Positive integer scheduling budget; scoped default 180000 ms, legacy unbounded. No remote cancellation.
inputs.definitions: Named definition library; see definition expand.
inputs.recipe: Optional durable {id,bindings}; saved pinned document required. See docs/DEFINITIONS.md.
inputs.operations: Ordered leaf, use, repeat or forEach steps. Leaf component overrides outer scope for this step; defaults do not inherit previous steps. onExisting error|reuse controls exact report replay only.
inputs.runId: Unique identity; defaults report directory to .fmcad-batch/runId.
inputs.reportPath: Local DIRECTORY containing immutable numbered JSON snapshots and an exclusive run.lock.
inputs.mode: Integrator sets run; context.preview always forces offline preview.
inputs.atomic: Boolean, default true. Omitted or true selects the atomic command transaction; only explicit false selects non-atomic per-step execution. Invalid types are rejected, never coerced. The effective mode is part of the replay identity.

limitations: Atomic mode requires the addin backend (atomicBatch capability); the official mcp backend is rejected before any mutation with a specific reason, never silently downgraded. Save/export/document-lifecycle and local/node-only steps are rejected inside an atomic batch.

Atomic reports distinguish committed/aborted/rejected/unknown and include terminationReason and rollbackVerified (distinct from the abort request). abortRequested does not imply verified revert; appearances/materials/attributes/transforms are undocumented for rollback.

Explicit atomic: false preserves the legacy per-step semantics and marks the report non-atomic with no transactional protection. A timeout stays unknown with no automatic replay; a client timeout does not cancel the Fusion command.

batch.summary.summary: Read historical batch outcomes from the latest local numbered report; no model validation.

inputs.step: Optional 1-based step number; 0 and out-of-range values fail.

limitations: Historical reported outcomes only, never current model validation, replay or mutation. No document, config or backend access.

Reads the highest numbered snapshot in contiguous history starting at 00000000.json; missing, incomplete or corrupt reports fail. Stale locks and temporary files are ignored, not removed. Running snapshots may contain pending steps.
TEXT by default; --json returns the summary schema with historical:true, modelValidated:false and stored success/status. Failed history exits nonzero.

batch.reconcile.summary: Read-only inspection of a batch receipt and matching live holder; it never opens or activates a document.

inputs.operations: Optional array of at most 100 {operation,data} entries; existing read-only CAD handlers only.
inputs.blockedJobId: Optional exact needs_reconciliation job id for one broker-scoped atomic_status observation while that job blocks admission.
inputs.commandId: Required with blockedJobId; exact commandId from that atomic report.
inputs.sessionNonce: Required with blockedJobId; exact session nonce from that atomic report.

limitations: Observation only; no report writes, lock removal, activation, open, replay or recovery mutation. Outcome remains unknown without matching durable/native evidence.

batch.finalize.summary: Clean up this batch's native command after destroy, idle, and exact receipt/holder identity checks.
limitations: Only the exact owned command can be finalized. Does not open/activate documents, restart, cancel, replay, or remove another writer's lock; unknown remains unknown.

definition.instantiate.summary: Instantiate an ordered batch using literal JSON parameter substitution, without code evaluation.

inputs.timeBudgetMs: Positive integer scheduling budget; scoped default 180000 ms, legacy unbounded. No remote cancellation.
inputs.definitions: Named definition library; see definition expand.
inputs.recipe: Optional durable {id,bindings}; saved pinned document required. See docs/DEFINITIONS.md.
inputs.parameters: Literal JSON values; no code evaluation or interpolation.

limitations: Same persistence, replay, and failure limitations as batch.run (non-atomic per-step execution; the atomic default applies to batch.run/validate/preview). Definition expansion is not a CAD task planner.
